name: @engenox/kg
description: The truth-spine typed access — the ONLY sanctioned bi-temporal query path (assertion_view, 13 §3). libs/kg sits BELOW the service layer; it never imports a service (24 §3). The thin-column ships a dev in-memory AssertionStore; the AssertionStore PORT is the long-term contract — the thickening swaps the store impl (CNPG + AGE per ADR-0003), never the access contract. Every appended node is bi-temporal: valid_time + tx_time are mandatory on every assertion (06 §7 invariant 2 + 13 §2), enforced by the type, not optional.
